title: RCT Inverter — QuestDB
description: Live power flow, battery SOC, inverter operating state, device connectivity and per-device breakdown queried from the QuestDB export (table "${table}") via the official QuestDB Grafana plugin (questdb-questdb-datasource). Targets QuestDB 10.x SQL and Grafana 13.x dashboard schema.

list.name: table
list.label: Table
list.description: Measurement/table name; matches the operator-configurable questdb_measurement_name setting (default "rct").

list.name: device
list.definition: SELECT device FROM ${table} LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY device ORDER BY device;

query.rawSql: SELECT device FROM ${table} LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY device ORDER BY device;

list.label: Device

list.name: rollup_view
list.label: Rollup view (auto)
list.description: Current materialized rollup view for ${table}, discovered dynamically because its name is content-hashed and changes whenever the exported column set changes.
list.definition: SELECT view_name FROM materialized_views() WHERE base_table_name = '${table}' AND view_status = 'valid' ORDER BY view_name DESC LIMIT 1;

query.rawSql: SELECT view_name FROM materialized_views() WHERE base_table_name = '${table}' AND view_status = 'valid' ORDER BY view_name DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Live power flow (PV / grid / battery / load)
panels.description: Summed across the selected device(s), one pass over the raw table (no UNION ALL). PV = rct_solar_a_power_watts + rct_solar_b_power_watts. $__conditionalAll lets 'All' devices skip the IN-filter instead of listing every device.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       sum(rct_grid_power_watts) AS "Grid",
       sum(rct_battery_power_watts) AS "Battery",
       sum(rct_solar_a_power_watts + rct_solar_b_power_watts) AS "PV",
       sum(rct_household_load_power_watts) AS "Household load"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Battery SOC (latest)
panels.description: Current battery state of charge per device, with its own age in seconds so a stale reading is visible. Raw column rct_battery_soc_ratio is 0.0-1.0, scaled to percent here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, device AS metric, rct_battery_soc_ratio * 100 AS value FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device) ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Inverter operating state
panels.description: Operating-state enum (standby, feed_in, hardware_check, ...) from rct_inverter_state, one series per state label, value 1 while that state is active. This is NOT a connectivity signal: a device that stopped exporting hours ago keeps showing its last operating state here. See "Device connectivity" for online/offline, derived from export staleness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, device AS metric, state AS value FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device) AND rct_inverter_state = 1 ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Per-device breakdown (latest)
panels.description: Latest power/SOC reading per device with its own age in seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device,
       rct_grid_power_watts AS grid_power_w,
       rct_battery_power_watts AS battery_power_w,
       rct_battery_soc_ratio * 100 AS battery_soc_percent,
       rct_household_load_power_watts AS household_load_w,
       rct_ac_power_watts AS ac_power_w,
       (cast(now() as long) / 1000000.0 - cast(timestamp as long) / 1000000.0) AS age_seconds
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY device;

panels.title: Device connectivity (last success / errors)
panels.description: No boolean online column exists; connectivity is derived from the staleness of rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds (offline once the last successful transaction is older than 120s, roughly 4x the default 30s export interval) together with rct_device_errors_total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device,
       rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds AS last_success_unix_seconds,
       rct_device_errors_total AS errors_total,
       CASE
         WHEN rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
         WHEN (cast(now() as long) / 1000000.0 - rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds) > 120 THEN 'offline'
         ELSE 'online'
       END AS connectivity
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY device;

panels.title: Grid power — long range (rollup view)
panels.description: Retention-aware: queries the current materialized rollup view (${rollup_view}), discovered dynamically via materialized_views() rather than a hardcoded content-hashed name, instead of the raw table whose TTL can be as short as 1 day. No FILL is applied, so an export gap renders as a gap rather than an interpolated value. Empty if no downsampling preset is configured (no rollup view exists yet).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, 'Grid power (avg)' AS metric, "rct_grid_power_watts_avg" AS value
FROM "${rollup_view}"
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: ☀️ Südseite
panels.description: Solar generator A, summed across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_solar_a_power_watts (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0xDB11855B "Solar generator A power", unit W).

panels.title: ☀️ Nordseite
panels.description: Solar generator B, summed across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_solar_b_power_watts (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0x0CB5D21B "Solar generator B power", unit W).

panels.title: ⚡Aktueller Verbrauch
panels.description: Household load, summed across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_household_load_power_watts (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0x1AC87AA0 "Household load including external power", unit W). Thresholds match the reference dashboard's green/yellow/orange/red ramp.

panels.title: ⚡Aktuelle Einspeisung
panels.description: Grid feed-in magnitude, summed across the selected device(s): rct_grid_power_watts is signed (app/gateway/conventions.py RctGridPowerConvention, dispatch_grid_import_positive defaults to true -> positive = draw/import, negative = feed-in). Feed-in is shown as the positive magnitude of the negative branch. If an operator has set DISPATCH_GRID_IMPORT_POSITIVE=false, this query and panel 12 must be swapped.

panels.title: ⚡Aktueller Bezug
panels.description: Grid draw magnitude, summed across the selected device(s): the positive branch of the signed rct_grid_power_watts column (see panel 11 for the sign convention and the swap note).

Overall connectivity across the selected device(s): OFFLINE if any device's rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds is older than 120s (same staleness rule as panel 6 "Device connectivity"), otherwise ONLINE. Value mapping only, no numeric display.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(online) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT device,
         CASE
           WHEN rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds IS NULL THEN 0
           WHEN (cast(now() as long) / 1000000.0 - rct_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds) > 120 THEN 0
           ELSE 1
         END AS online
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY device
);

panels.title: 🔋SoC
panels.description: Average battery state of charge across the selected device(s). Raw column rct_battery_soc_ratio is 0.0-1.0, scaled to percent. Thresholds match the reference dashboard's panel-1 ramp (red<30, orange<50, #EAB839<70, green>=70).

panels.title: 🔋 Battery Temp.
panels.description: Average battery temperature across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_battery_temperature_celsius (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0x902AFAFB "Battery temperature", unit °C, preselected: true -> exported by default; app/observability/names.py maps unit "°C" to the "celsius" suffix).

panels.title: 🔋 Cycles
panels.description: Maximum reported battery cycle count across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_battery_cycles (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0xC0DF2978 "battery.cycles", t_int32, unit "" -> no unit suffix per app/observability/names.py prometheus_name(), preselected: true).

panels.title: ⚡Produktion
panels.description: PV production per string plus grid feed-in magnitude (same sign convention as panel 11), stacked area, summed across the selected device(s). This is an addition alongside panel 1 "Live power flow", not a replacement: panel 1 still shows grid/battery/PV-total/load together, this one restyles the PV+feed-in slice as a stacked area matching the reference dashboard's "⚡Produktion" panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       sum(rct_solar_a_power_watts) AS "PV A",
       sum(rct_solar_b_power_watts) AS "PV B",
       sum(CASE WHEN rct_grid_power_watts < 0 THEN -rct_grid_power_watts ELSE 0 END) AS "Einspeisung"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp;

panels.title: Autarkie (Total)
panels.description: Lifetime self-sufficiency: (consumed - drawn from grid) / consumed, aggregated across the selected device(s). Verified columns: rct_energy_e_load_total_watt_hours (object_id 0xEFF4B537 "energy.e_load_total", Wh, preselected: true) and rct_energy_grid_load_total_watt_hours (object_id 0x62FBE7DC "Total energy grid load", Wh, preselected: true).

panels.title: Produktion (Total)
panels.description: Lifetime AC production total, summed across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_energy_e_ac_total_sum (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0x79C0A724 "energy.e_ac_total_sum"; this registry entry's unit is empty, so no unit suffix is appended per app/observability/names.py prometheus_name() -- unlike its day/month/year siblings this one is NOT recorded with unit Wh in the registry, verify the raw scale before trusting absolute values). NOTE: preselected is false, so this metric is not exported by default; add "energy_e_ac_total_sum" to periodic_metrics/metrics_exposed_names (operator setting) for this panel to show data -- flagged for the user's decision rather than left silently empty or fabricated.

panels.title: Eingespeist (Total)
panels.description: Lifetime grid feed-in total, summed across the selected device(s). Verified column: rct_energy_e_grid_feed_total_watt_hours (app/catalog/objects.json object_id 0x44D4C533 "Total energy grid feed-in", Wh, preselected: true -> exported by default). The protocol defines no sign for this counter; passed through unchanged.

panels.title: Tagesstatistik
panels.description: Daily produced vs. consumed energy, kWh. QuestDB keyed SAMPLE BY groups by device plus the 1-day bucket; last() per device-day picks that device's day-counter value, which the device itself resets to 0 at local midnight, so last() already IS that day's total (no delta computation needed). Summed across the selected device(s). Verified columns: rct_energy_e_ac_day_watt_hours (object_id 0xBD55905F "energy.e_ac_day", Wh, preselected: true) and rct_energy_e_load_day_watt_hours (object_id 0x2F3C1D7D "energy.e_load_day", Wh, preselected: true).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       sum(produced) AS "Produced (kWh)",
       sum(consumed) AS "Consumed (kWh)"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, device,
         last(rct_energy_e_ac_day_watt_hours) / 1000.0 AS produced,
         last(rct_energy_e_load_day_watt_hours) / 1000.0 AS consumed
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
  SAMPLE BY 1d ALIGN TO CALENDAR
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Autarkie (pro Tag)
panels.description: Daily self-sufficiency: (consumed - drawn from grid) / consumed per day, same keyed-SAMPLE-BY day-counter approach as panel 18. Verified columns: rct_energy_e_load_day_watt_hours (see panel 18) and rct_energy_e_grid_load_day_watt_hours (object_id 0x867DEF7D "energy.e_grid_load_day", Wh, preselected: true).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       (sum(consumed) - sum(grid_draw)) / sum(consumed) * 100 AS "Autarkie"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, device,
         last(rct_energy_e_load_day_watt_hours) AS consumed,
         last(rct_energy_e_grid_load_day_watt_hours) AS grid_draw
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(device IN (${device:sqlstring}), $device)
  SAMPLE BY 1d ALIGN TO CALENDAR
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;
